steps.en: Install and start the server, wiring an embedding model and a VLM
steps.zh: 装好服务端并起进程，接上 embedding 与视觉模型

steps.en: Feed it the repositories and documents you want it to hold
steps.zh: 把要长期留住的仓库与文档喂进去

steps.en: Parses, builds the directory tree, writes L0/L1 summaries, indexes it
steps.zh: 解析、建目录树、后台写 L0/L1 摘要、建索引

steps.en: Install the memory plugin into the coding agent you already use
steps.zh: 给你已经在用的编码 agent 装上记忆插件

steps.en: Recalls memories before each prompt; captures each finished turn
steps.zh: 每次提问先召回并注入记忆，每轮回答后捕获

steps.en: Archives the session, extracts memories, merges or drops them
steps.zh: 归档会话，把对话抽成记忆，与旧记忆去重合并

value.en: You stop hand-writing memory files and re-explaining context every session
value.zh: 你不用再手写记忆文件，也不用每次重新交代背景
